mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment signals robust labor market conditions and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS growth is positive, SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it indicates a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and rising housing starts (HOUST > 1600.0) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE < 4.0% AND HOUST > 1600.0, SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 300), persistent price pressures prompt central bank hawkishness and reduce real equity returns, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 300, SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1600.0, it signals weakening residential demand and broader economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1600.0, SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.8%) reflects a tight monetary policy in a strong labor market, which typically precedes economic deceleration and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with strong labor market
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 5.0% AND UNRATE < 3.8%, SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates sustained economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 growth is positive, SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 102.0 signals manufacturing contraction and economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 102.0, SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 55% of cases.
